events.name: Bash
events.input: git status --short | head; ls -a; ls .github/workflows 2><path>; find . -name '*.sh' -not -path './.git/*' | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.input: cat -n scripts/check-drift.sh; cat -n .github/workflows/drift.yml; ls scripts deploy templates

events.output:
1	#!<path> bash
     2	# Compare every deployed config with the template it was rendered from and
     3	# report each file that drifted, with the team that owns its template.
     4	set -euo pipefail
     5	
     6	checked=0
     7	drifted=0
     8	
     9	for expected in templates/*.conf; do
...

events.name: Bash
events.input:
python3 - <<'E'
p='scripts/check-drift.sh'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("for expected in templates/*.conf; do","shopt -s nullglob\ntemplates=(templates/*.conf)\nif [[ ${#templates[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then\n...

events.output:
ok: drift reported
ok: no owner line
ok: clean
ok: missing deploy
ok: no templates
failures: 0
rc=0
drift check: 3 checked, 0 drifted
rc=0

events.name: Bash
events.input: printf '      - name: Test the drift check\n        run: bash scripts/test-check-drift.sh\n' >> .github/workflows/drift.yml && tail -5 .github/workflows/drift.yml

events.output:
- uses: actions/checkout@1af3b93b6815bc44a9784bd300feb67ff0d1eeb3
      - name: Compare deployed configs with their templates
        run: bash scripts/check-drift.sh
      - name: Test the drift check
        run: bash scripts/test-check-drift.sh
